items.text: Building strong roots for a sustainable future.

The MAPOU tree is a symbol of strength, deep roots, and resilience in the Caribbean. It represents the four core values that drive our work at RADIKAL, ensuring our projects are community-owned, sustainable, and impactful.
We organize and empower farmer and artisan networks through collective effort, believing that the greatest solutions are found together.
Our commitment to eco-friendly and climate-resilient practices ensures we are not just solving today's problems but are protecting the land for future generations.
We insist that all project design and implementation be led and owned by the local communities, guaranteeing relevance and long-term success.
We focus on creating viable economic opportunities and ensuring that communities gain full ownership of the resources and benefits generated.
